messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered for control-plane - elevated 5xx rates observed from gateway -> orglookup (auto-alert: high error rate and latency). Notifying on-call.

maya: saw the spike ~03:12 UTC, gateway 5xx rate up ~6x. Grafana link -> https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/ctrlplane-errors (private).

jordan: confirm this is primarily orglookup timeouts? I see traces pointing at org-lookup.svc cluster with request timeout 200ms.

lee: copying a few logs from the gateway at 03:12:45:

```
Gateway ERROR: remote call failed: org-lookup.svc: timeout after 200ms
 upstream_error=502 path=/v1/models/list user=svc-ingest
 stack=org.lookup.Client.Timeout
```

sam: prometheus headcount: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway",status=~"5.."}[1m])) by (route)` shows spikes on `/v1/org/*` routes. non-org routes steady.

alex: think it's a thundering fanout from session bootstrap jobs - many clients request org metadata on every auth. Could be cache TTL regression from last deploy.

maya: can we flip gateway to use stale cache fallback while we triage? That will avoid spiking orglookup. Is there a quick flag?

jordan: yes - there's a runtime toggle to allow stale-on-error for org cache: `gateway.runtime.orgcache.stale_on_error=true`. I'm pushing to prod canary now.

ops-bot: Deploy started by jordan: `svc/gateway` config patch -> runtime toggle set (canary 10% traffic). CI job: #3847.

lee: canary looks good for 10% - 5xx down by 40% for that slice. Rolling to 50%.

sam: also opening a short-lived circuit-breaker on gateway fanout to orglookup to short-circuit repeated calls from the same request: `gateway.circuit.orglookup.threshold=5` (30s window). Pushing now.

jordan: applied circuit breaker. Metrics: orglookup QPS dropped 60% within 90s. Timeouts reduced.

maya: quick customer impact note: error budget: ~7% of control-plane requests failed at peak, mostly affecting org-scoped read endpoints. No broad data loss, but UI errors for org-switch in apps. Support: flagging high-visibility customers (acct: redwood-enterprise, alpha-inc) for proactive outreach.

alex: root cause hypothesis: recent config rollout increased org cache TTL to 0s for a small subset of nodes (bug in rollout gating). That removes local cache and increases downstream fanout.

lee: pulling the deploy history: config rollout 03:08 UTC changed `orgcache.ttl` on 3 nodes (bad template). Reverting those nodes now.

ops-bot: Revert started by lee -> ConfigSet:orgcache/2026-03-15-reduce-ttl (partial rollback).

sam: while revert rolls, I'm scaling org-lookup service from 6 -> 18 replicas (k8s HPA pump). Command run: `kubectl scale deploy org-lookup --replicas=18 -n controlplane`

jordan: scaling applied. Latency per request dropping, error rates continue trending down.

maya: end-user visible: errors dropped from 7% -> 1.1% over 7 minutes after both stale_on_error and circuit-breaker + scale + partial revert. Good progress.

alex: we should also add a temporary route-level quota to reduce rebuild storms from background syncs: `gateway.rate_limit.org_meta_burst=1000/min` until config validated.

sam: added quota. telemetry shows tail latencies reduced.

maya: onboarding note: handoff - oncall-shift will take live ownership for the next 45 minutes to watch for recurrence and finish customer communications.

oncall-shift: taking over. I'll keep an eye on the dashboards and follow up with triage notes.

lee: next steps / immediate action items:
- make the orgcache TTL revert permanent for the affected template nodes (lee)
- add a guarded feature flag for cache TTL changes in rollout pipeline (jordan)
- add automated stale_on_error fallback for gateway with safe default true (sam)
- postmortem and RCA (maya owner)

maya: creating incident ticket and will own the postmortem: https://incidents.redwood/internal/3909997777 (will attach timeline + metrics + customer impact).

ops-bot: Incident severity: SEV2 (customer-facing errors, mitigated, follow up required). Pager silenced at 03:25 UTC.

jordan: quick debug snippet we used for tracing diagnostic -> run in devbox:
```
# prometheus query to check per-pod latency
kubectl port-forward svc/prometheus 9090:9090 -n monitoring
curl -g "http://localhost:9090/api/v1/query?query=histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=\"org-lookup\"}[5m])) by (le, pod))"
```

maya: thanks team. Logging action items into the ticket and scheduling postmortem for 48 hours. Marking incident resolved for now. :white_check_mark:

oncall-shift: leaving a note - if you see a resurgence, escalate to oncall lead and we re-open pager.

alex: for completeness: patch to rollout gating PR #3952 (jordan) and runbook update PR #92 (sam) in flight.

maya: closing thread once postmortem is filed. Good job everyone. :thumbsup:
